item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00411","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C05","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 is an earlier Columbus Day proclamation built around the same congressional authorization and the same operative package: designate October 12 as Columbus Day, direct display of the flag on government buildings, and invite public observance through commemorative ceremonies. The child updates the date, anniversary, and descriptive recitals but retains this concrete drafting structure and closely parallel language. C05 and C23 contain similar observance-and-flag provisions, but C12 is substantially more specific to the child and therefore the clear template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Congress of the United States, by a joint resolution approved April 30, 1934 (48 Stat. 657), has authorized and requested the President to issue a proclamation designating October 12 of each year as Columbus Day","parent_excerpt":"the Congress of the United States, by a joint resolution approved April 30, 1934 (48 Stat. 657(), authorized and requested the President to issue a proclamation designating October 12 of each year as Columbus Day","explanation":"The same statutory recital is reproduced with only minor grammatical and typographical variation."},{"child_excerpt":"do by this proclamation designate Saturday, the twelfth day of October, 1957, as Columbus Day","parent_excerpt":"by this proclamation designate Friday, October 12, 1951, as Columbus Day","explanation":"The central designation clause follows the same formulation, adapted to the new year and weekday."},{"child_excerpt":"I invite the people of this Nation to observe that day with appropriate ceremonies in commemoration of the four hundred and sixty-fifth anniversary","parent_excerpt":"I also invite the people of this country to observe the day with ceremonies designed to honor the discoverer of America","explanation":"Both call for popular ceremonial observance honoring Columbus."},{"child_excerpt":"I also direct that the flag of the United States be displayed on all public buildings on that day","parent_excerpt":"I direct the appropriate officials to arrange for the display of the flag of the United States on all Government buildings on that day","explanation":"The child retains the same flag-display directive while simplifying the administrative phrasing."}]}
